mosaic.note: no tag at this commit; the commit is the pin. pyproject declares git-only and mutually unsatisfiable back-ends (its `esm` needs torch 2.11 vs its own torch==2.7.1): install joltz, boltz and the public requirements first, then mosaic with --no-deps (environment/requirements.lock: the whole set at its versions, the three upstream packages as `name @ git+https://...@<commit>` lines, installed --no-deps). The archive carries src/mosaic/proteinmpnn/weights/ (three .pt files, 33 MB: [tool.hatch.build] artifacts)

joltz.note: no tag at this commit; pyproject declares boltz>=2.0.3 (floating): the escalante fork pin below is the boltz this tree runs

boltz.note: escalante-bio fork of jwohlwend/boltz; no tag at this commit. Provides the torch Boltz2 module the checkpoint loads into, the featurizer (process_inputs) and download_boltz2

archive_recipe: git archive --format=tar --prefix=<name>-<commit8>/ <commit> <paths> | gzip -n -9  (mosaic: src/mosaic pyproject.toml LICENSE README.md; joltz: src/joltz pyproject.toml LICENSE NOTICE README.md; boltz: src/boltz pyproject.toml LICENSE README.md)

pinned_stack.container_base: nvidia/cuda:12.8.1-runtime-ubuntu22.04 + CPython 3.12.1 (python-build-standalone), the stack in the virtual environment /kit/venv (environment/Dockerfile; the distribution list is environment/requirements.lock)
pinned_stack.install: environment/requirements.lock, every distribution at its version, pip install --no-deps into a virtual environment (README.md 'Setup'; environment/Dockerfile builds /kit/venv the same way); the kit's lever files, copied into site-packages/mosaic/fast/ by run.sh install (opt/mosaic_opt/leverfiles.py), are not part of the stock install

system.compiler: none required at run time (XLA emits its own fusions; no Triton)
system.note: the declared-but-omitted packages are not imported on the Boltz-2 path (src/mosaic/__init__.py is empty; the Boltz-2 modules import jax, torch, numpy, equinox, jaxtyping, gemmi, boltz, joltz, scipy, mosaic and the standard library)

boltz2_conf.ckpt.source: boltz.main.download_boltz2() — public Boltz hosts (model-gateway.boltz.bio, huggingface.co/boltz-community/boltz-2); downloaded on first Boltz2() when absent (src/mosaic/losses/boltz2.py:49-55)

joltz_parameters.source: joltz.from_torch at load time (src/mosaic/losses/boltz2.py:79); recorded by the kit driver as params_sha256_all_leaves

ccd.path: $MOSAIC_CACHE_DIR/boltz/mols.tar, unpacked to mols/ by the same call
ccd.note: the archive is the pinned unit: install --weights hashes mols.tar and refuses it off the pin; mols/ is its content; the driver's results.json records what was loaded

proteinmpnn.path: src/mosaic/proteinmpnn/weights/ (inside the mosaic archive; installed under site-packages/mosaic/proteinmpnn/weights/)
proteinmpnn.source: committed in escalante-bio/mosaic @ 70fec525; the files are tracked in this repo's archive (stock/mosaic-70fec525.tar.gz) at that commit — named by the commit, not by a stored digest

entry_point.features: model.binder_features(binder_length=L, chains=[TargetChain(seq)])  (examples/boltz_notebook.py:101; TargetChain.use_msa defaults to True, src/mosaic/structure_prediction.py:27)
entry_point.loss: model.build_loss(loss=2*BinderTargetContact() + WithinBinderContact() + 5.0*InverseFoldingSequenceRecovery(mpnn, temp=0.01), features=features)  (examples/boltz_notebook.py:119-124; recycling_steps=1, sampling_steps=25, deterministic=True, src/mosaic/models/boltz2.py:143-150)
entry_point.design: simplex_APGM(loss, n_steps=75, x=softmax(0.5*gumbel(key, (L,20))), stepsize=0.1, momentum=0.0) then simplex_APGM(loss, n_steps=50, x=PSSM, stepsize=0.5, scale=1.5, momentum=0.0)  (examples/boltz_notebook.py:136-146, 154-160)
entry_point.script: opt/mosaic_opt/tools/public_design_run.py --weights torch (the kit driver with every lever off; the one scriptable form of the calls above: opt/mosaic_opt/stock_design.py)

notebook.note: the recipe module, copied from the pinned commit; not part of the installable archive (archive_recipe packages src/mosaic only)

library_defaults.seed: np.random.randint(100000) for x0; key(0) for the refold (examples/boltz_notebook.py:141, 198)
library_defaults.precision: JAX defaults (float32; no JAX_DEFAULT_MATMUL_PRECISION, no JAX_ENABLE_X64)
library_defaults.note: the kit driver's form of the recipe (tools/recipe.py, the one recipe module): binder_length 80, the public target single-sequence (use_msa=False) by default, any protein target by --target-fasta with its MSA from a staged alignment by --msa <boltz processed .csv | .a3m> (use_msa=True with the ColabFold fetch done ahead of time; no server is contacted), explicit keys (tools/public_design_run.py:5-12)

stock_environment.note: MOSAIC_CACHE_DIR is the library's own weights-cache variable (src/mosaic/cache.py:11), the one exception. The package's own path variables (MOSAIC_OPT_HOME, MOSAIC_OPT_KIT, MOSAIC_OPT_CACHE_ROOT) carry the MOSAIC_OPT prefix and are stripped from every arm's environment like its switches (opt/mosaic_opt/driver.py compose); the package reads them in its own process only. JAX_ENABLE_X64 / JAX_DEFAULT_MATMUL_PRECISION are refused for every arm, stock included (the kit never changes precision: opt/mosaic_opt/det.py MUST_BE_UNSET). XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_PREALLOCATE and PYTHONUNBUFFERED are the allocator / stdio settings the kit exports for every arm (opt/mosaic_opt/det.py ENV) and are tolerated
